mapper.select:
SELECT operation, requestCount, errorCount, q[1] AS p50, q[2] AS p90, q[3] AS p99 FROM ( SELECT SpanName AS operation, toUInt64(count()) AS requestCount, toUInt64(countIf(StatusCode = 'Error')) AS errorCount, quantiles(0.5, 0.9, 0.99)(Duration) AS q FROM quasar_tracing.spans WHERE ServiceName = #{service} AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND Timestamp BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{from}) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{to})
GROUP BY operation )
SELECT operation, requestCount, errorCount, q[1] AS p50, q[2] AS p90, q[3] AS p99 FROM ( SELECT span_name AS operation, toUInt64(sumMerge(request_count)) AS requestCount, toUInt64(sumMerge(error_count)) AS errorCount, quantilesMerge(0.5, 0.9, 0.99)(duration_quantiles) AS q FROM quasar_tracing.service_endpoint_summary WHERE service_name = #{service} AND span_kind = 'Server' AND time_bucket BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{from}) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{to}) GROUP BY operation )
ORDER BY requestCount DESC

SELECT serviceInstanceId, requestCount, errorCount, p99, resourceAttributes FROM ( SELECT if(indexOf(mapKeys(ResourceAttributes), 'service.instance.id') = 0, '', arrayElement(mapValues(ResourceAttributes), indexOf(mapKeys(ResourceAttributes), 'service.instance.id'))) AS serviceInstanceId, toUInt64(count()) AS requestCount, toUInt64(countIf(StatusCode = 'Error')) AS errorCount, quantile(0.99)(Duration) AS p99, any(ResourceAttributes) AS resourceAttributes FROM quasar_tracing.spans WHERE ServiceName = #{service} AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND Timestamp BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{from}) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{to})
GROUP BY serviceInstanceId ) WHERE serviceInstanceId != '' ORDER BY requestCount DESC

WITH memory AS ( SELECT serviceInstanceId, argMax(heapUsed, timeUnix) AS heapUsed, argMax(heapLimit, timeUnix) AS heapLimit FROM ( SELECT ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS serviceInstanceId, TimeUnix AS timeUnix, sumIf(Value, MetricName = 'jvm.memory.used' AND Attributes['jvm.memory.type'] = 'heap') AS heapUsed, sumIf(Value, MetricName = 'jvm.memory.limit' AND Attributes['jvm.memory.type'] = 'heap') AS heapLimit FROM quasar_tracing.otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName = #{service} AND TimeUnix BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{from}) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{to}) AND MetricName IN ('jvm.memory.used', 'jvm.memory.limit')
GROUP BY serviceInstanceId, timeUnix ) WHERE serviceInstanceId != '' GROUP BY serviceInstanceId ), threads AS ( SELECT serviceInstanceId, argMax(threadCount, timeUnix) AS threadCount FROM ( SELECT ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS serviceInstanceId, TimeUnix AS timeUnix, sum(Value) AS threadCount FROM quasar_tracing.otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName = #{service} AND TimeUnix BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{from}) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{to}) AND MetricName = 'jvm.thread.count'
GROUP BY serviceInstanceId, timeUnix ) WHERE serviceInstanceId != '' GROUP BY serviceInstanceId ), cpu AS ( SELECT ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS serviceInstanceId, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS cpuUtilization FROM quasar_tracing.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName = #{service} AND TimeUnix BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{from}) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{to}) AND MetricName = 'jvm.cpu.recent_utilization'
GROUP BY serviceInstanceId ), gc AS ( SELECT serviceInstanceId, (sum(sumDuration) / nullIf(sum(countDuration), 0)) * 1000 AS gcDuration FROM ( SELECT ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS serviceInstanceId, TimeUnix AS timeUnix, sum(Sum) AS sumDuration, sum(Count) AS countDuration FROM quasar_tracing.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE ServiceName = #{service} AND TimeUnix BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{from}) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{to}) AND MetricName = 'jvm.gc.duration'
GROUP BY serviceInstanceId, timeUnix ) WHERE serviceInstanceId != '' GROUP BY serviceInstanceId ) SELECT memory.serviceInstanceId AS serviceInstanceId, heapUsed, heapLimit, cpuUtilization, threadCount, gcDuration FROM memory LEFT JOIN cpu USING serviceInstanceId LEFT JOIN threads USING serviceInstanceId LEFT JOIN gc USING serviceInstanceId

SELECT time, requests, errors, q[1] AS p50, q[2] AS p90, q[3] AS p99 FROM ( SELECT toUInt64(toUnixTimestamp(toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, toIntervalSecond(#{stepSec})))) * 1000 AS time, toFloat64(count()) AS requests, toFloat64(countIf(StatusCode = 'Error')) AS errors, quantiles(0.5, 0.9, 0.99)(Duration) AS q FROM quasar_tracing.spans WHERE ServiceName = #{service} AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND Timestamp BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{from}) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{to})
GROUP BY time )
SELECT time, requests, errors, q[1] AS p50, q[2] AS p90, q[3] AS p99 FROM ( SELECT toUInt64(toUnixTimestamp(toStartOfInterval(time_bucket, toIntervalSecond(#{stepSec})))) * 1000 AS time, toFloat64(sumMerge(request_count)) AS requests, toFloat64(sumMerge(error_count)) AS errors, quantilesMerge(0.5, 0.9, 0.99)(duration_quantiles) AS q FROM quasar_tracing.service_endpoint_summary WHERE service_name = #{service} AND span_kind = 'Server' AND time_bucket BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{from}) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{to}) GROUP BY time )
ORDER BY time
